artifact: Expert communication & learning path — consolidated method

communication_doctrines.name: composition-is-the-qualifier
communication_doctrines.rule: Expert system; repos are expert onboarding. Have a composition (parts of a whole tracked in order, within a budget) = you have the need; if not, not your tool. State purpose at the front door.

communication_doctrines.name: kind-exclusive-club
communication_doctrines.rule: Friendly, humble rejection — 'sorry, compositions only' — explained, with better-suited methods named and goodwill offered. Win-win-win; no time wasted.

communication_doctrines.name: no-advertisement
communication_doctrines.rule: Tell it, show it, offer it for reproduction, then stop. The audience that can use it already has the need; advertising wastes resource.

communication_doctrines.name: dont-narrate-intent
communication_doctrines.rule: Write to a phantom audience of experts; make the work legible to the field's best; never address them, never explain intent. Protesting non-outreach reads as neediness. Confidence in what is provable; silence on what is not.

communication_doctrines.name: names-off-repo-unless-cited
communication_doctrines.rule: A target expert audience is a writing instrument kept off-repo. Published-paper citations (author-year) are scholarship and welcome; naming a person as contact/target is not. No false collaboration claims; inspiration only; names move on-repo only when an official collaboration exists.

communication_doctrines.name: match-register
communication_doctrines.rule: Science audience: honest tiers + reproduction first. Power/confidence audience (finance): lead with provable certainty + reproducibility, then temper with the science declaration of bias/limits/bounds. Confidence is epistemic (what the data reveals + that it reproduces), never about the future.

communication_doctrines.name: honest-envelope
communication_doctrines.rule: Tier 1 (verified, reproducible) vs Tier 3 (the expert's meaning). Holds-or-warns, never a confident wrong answer. Descriptive, not advice — emphatically in finance and medicine. Public/aggregate data only on the repo.

communication_doctrines.name: paper-repo-division
communication_doctrines.rule: Higher intelligence -> the paper; vast data effort -> the repository; a content-hash receipt binds them. See papers/PAPER_AND_REPO_DIVISION.md.

outcomes.HIGHER_DOOR: raw data isn't a composition but a composition of samples/methods/observers might be — study the studiers; re-run the gauge on that mix

induction_map.rule: each stage has a pass-gauge; graduated not permission-gated; skip ahead if already qualified

learning_path.users: pass the gauge -> learn what Hs gives at your D -> run your data + get a receipt -> find the worked run nearest your field -> pick your purpose -> experiment in the playground -> graduate to a reproducible, traceable node
ai_assistant_protocol: Gate first: confirm a composition; if the user wants advice/forecast/probability, say plainly Hs does not produce those and stop, kindly; deliver only what the data reveals.
Compose on request: turn the user's operated system into a composition (rows=order, cols=parts summing to a whole); validate with the gauge; keep private data local.
Run + receipt: always surface the content_hash; never report a result without it.
Translate: map the reading into the user's own field language.
Hold the bounds: Tier 1 reading vs Tier 3 meaning; descriptive not advice; holds-or-warns; public framing on anything shared.
learning_path.convention: every domain folder carries an AI_ASSIST.json; onboarding nodes are distributed, not central

throughline: Same discipline from engine to outreach: non-perturbing, honest, reproducible. The instrument doesn't disturb the data; the communication doesn't disturb the reader; onboarding wastes no time; the assistant refuses to bluff. Data is the star; Hs is the lens; the receipt is the proof.
